sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the appellants/claimants 2 - 8 in OP (MV) No.640 of 2004 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Kalpetta.
The respondents herein are the respondents before the Tribunal.

2. According to the claimants, on 24.08.2004, at about 9.45 p.m., while the deceased was travelling in an autorickshaw bearing registration No.KL-12A/3970 from Valliyoorkavu To Mananthavady, an ambulance van bearing registration No.KL- 01/B-2128 driven by the first respondent in a rash and negligent manner hit against the autorickshaw, and as a result, the deceased sustained serious injuries and succumbed to the injuries.

The appellants who are the legal heirs of the deceased,
approached the Tribunal claiming a total compensation of 10,00,000/-.
3. Before the Tribunal, the first, second and third 2025:KER:50491 MACA NO. 782 OF 2014 respondents were the driver, owner and the insurer of the offending vehicle respectively.
Though notice was served on first and second respondents, they remained absent and were set ex parte.
The third respondent - insurer filed a written statement, admitting the insurance policy, denying the liability and quantum of compensation claimed.
They contended that the petition is bad for non-joinder of necessary parties, since the driver, owner and the insurer of the autorickshaw were not impleaded in the party array.
Before the Tribunal, Exts.A1 to A7 were marked and PW1 was examined.

The Tribunal, after analysing the pleadings and materials on record, found that the accident occurred due to the rash and negligent driving of both the drivers, R1 and the driver of the autorickshaw and an award was passed for 4,72,600/- (50% of 9,45,200).

Since 50,000/- was already paid to the appellants under Section 140 of the Motor Vehicles Act, the appellants are awarded an amount of 4,22,600/- as compensation under different heads with interest @ 6% per annum from the date of 2025:KER:50491 MACA NO. 782 OF 2014 petition till realization with proportionate costs.
Dissatisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal, the claimants have come up in appeal.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the appellants, the learned Government Pleader and the learned counsel appearing for the first respondent - the driver of the ambulance van.
5. The learned counsel for the appellants sought enhancement of compensation under different heads.
However, the learned Government Pleader appearing for R2 and R3 submitted that the award was passed finding contributory negligence on the part of drivers of both ambulance and autorickshaw.
On a perusal of the award, it is seen that the owner, driver and insurer of the autorickshaw were not made parties to the proceedings.

The Tribunal as per the award has found contributory negligence on the part of both the drivers of the vehicle and directed the owner of the ambulance as well as the owner of the autorickshaw to pay compensation to the legal heirs 2025:KER:50491 MACA NO. 782 OF 2014 of the deceased.
The claimants, while filing the original petition before the Tribunal, failed to implead the owner, driver and insurer of the autorickshaw.

sentences.text: The Tribunal, without affording an opportunity to contest the matter, passed the award directing the owner as well as the driver of the autorickshaw to pay compensation to the legal heirs, which is unjustifiable.
Neither an enhanced compensation can be granted to the claimants without the owner and driver of the autorickshaw on the party array and without affording them an opportunity to contest the claim.
Therefore, I find that it appropriate to remand the matter back to the Tribunal.

Accordingly, the appeal is disposed of as follows The impugned award dated 21.10.2008 in O.P.(MV)
No.640 of 2004 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Wayanad, Kalpetta, is hereby set aside.

sentences.text: The matter is remanded back to the Tribunal for fresh consideration.
The claimants will be 2025:KER:50491 MACA NO. 782 OF 2014 at liberty to implead the owner, driver and insurer of the autorickshaw involved in the accident.
The Tribunal shall consider the matter and pass appropriate orders, in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible.
The parties are directed to appear before the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Wayanad, Kalpetta on 14.08.2025.
